Every BBBC022 output pixel was compared with its original TIFF, each source TIFF was checked against its recorded checksum and archive CRC, and all seven raw files passed git-annex checksum verification before upload. The manifest records each field's source filename, checksum, well, site, and image number. The repository includes a reproducible importer.
